concept: Split poster: a white typographic half (MAY 12 yellow tab bleeding top-left, headline on a pale panel underlined by the yellow bar, pink square locked to the panel's corner, address + contact at the foot) and the photo on the other half with pink / yellow squares pinned to its outer corners. Wide and square: photo right; tall: photo as the bottom band; banners: one-line headline, contact row at the bottom.
